notes.title: Version 1.4.5 Mini update
notes.notes:
Hello all!

Just a small update addressing balance issues of episode 3's middle difficulty mode. 

Also, a rare bug that caused an enemy to sometimes repeat an attack on the player, effectively scoring a freebie, has been fixed.

Also x2, NEW MINI FEATURE!! All episodes on Miner mode and Matthew mode have the option to skip the basic tutorial messages from popping up when you collect or kill something for the first time. In Episode 3 you have said option across all modes. 

Enjoy!!!
